name: Post dated opening balances and calculate owner's equity
description: Verifies a business can enter its starting asset and liability balances once, and the system posts a balanced journal with calculated owner's equity.
steps: Open Accounting and enter an opening date
Enter Cash on Hand of 50000, M-Pesa Wallet of 20000, Inventory Asset of 500000 and Accounts Payable of 100000
Post opening balances
Review the posted opening journal and balance sheet
expected: The opening journal is dated as selected, debits total KSh 570000, credits total KSh 570000 including calculated owner equity of KSh 470000, and the form is locked against a second posting.

name: Reject invalid or repeated opening balances
description: Verifies invalid amounts and a second opening balance submission are rejected without creating duplicate opening journals.
steps: Open the opening balance form
Try entering a negative amount or submit with no non-zero balances
After a valid opening journal exists, attempt another opening balance submission
expected: Invalid data is rejected with a visible message, and the business can have only one opening-balance journal.

name: Confirm opening balance entry is usable on mobile
description: Verifies the opening balance form can be completed and reviewed on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open Accounting on a mobile viewport before opening balances have been posted
Enter an opening date and two or more account balances
Review the calculated owner's equity and submit
expected: Account labels and amount inputs remain usable on mobile and the calculated equity is visible before posting.

name: Generate a Windows desktop pairing code
description: Verifies an authenticated business owner can generate a one-time code to pair a Windows computer.
steps: Sign in to the owner portal
Open Connectivity
Choose Generate pairing code
Review the displayed code and expiry
expected: An eight-digit pairing code, expiry time and clear instructions for entering the code in the Windows application are displayed.

name: Show a clear error when pairing-code generation fails
description: Verifies a failed pairing-code request is communicated without displaying a false success state.
steps: Sign in to the owner portal
Open Connectivity
Choose Generate pairing code
expected: A visible error explains that a pairing code could not be generated, and no pairing code is shown.

name: Require an authenticated Branch Manager for discounts
description: Verifies discount approval is tied to a configured Branch Manager credential rather than a cashier-entered name.
steps: Open Team and add a Branch Manager profile
Set a six-digit discount approval PIN for the manager
Open POS and add an item to the cart
Apply a discount and attempt checkout without manager approval
Select the configured Branch Manager and enter an incorrect PIN
Verify the sale is rejected
Enter the correct PIN and a reason for the discount
Complete the sale and review the discount audit entry
expected: Only a configured Branch Manager with a valid PIN can approve the discounted sale. The PIN is stored as a salted PBKDF2 hash, is never returned to the frontend, failed attempts are rate-limited, and the sale and audit log identify the approving manager and reason.

name: Reconcile cashier shift cash and M-Pesa balances
description: Verifies each shift calculates expected cash and M-Pesa from recorded payments and refunds and compares them with actual closing counts.
steps: Open a cashier shift with an opening float of KSh 5000
Complete a sale paid KSh 3000 cash and KSh 2000 M-Pesa
Complete another sale paid KSh 1000 cash
Record and settle a KSh 500 cash refund during the shift
Close the shift with KSh 8500 cash and KSh 2000 M-Pesa counted
Review the reconciliation summary and audit record
expected: Expected cash is KSh 8500 (opening float plus cash sales less cash refunds), expected M-Pesa is KSh 2000, both variances are zero, and the closed shift retains its complete reconciliation summary.
